research_question: Does the locked MR-STFT waveform objective conflict with event BCE on the parameters actually shared by B1's waveform and event paths?
status: COMPLETED 2026-09-17 on CPU: preregistered conflict gate failed; see docs/audits/Q1_SHARED_GRADIENT_CONFLICT_AUDIT.md
source_runs: Completed L3 checkpoints from q1_continuous_ecg_loss_ablation on loso_v2 validation folds 1/5/9
architecture_fact: L3 used CENet arm B1 with LegacyDecoder. The actually shared parameters are wsst_stem plus decoder.tcn. decoder.head and decoder.event are task-specific; B2 fusion and upsampling are not part of this audit.

losses.event: 0.20 * BCEWithLogits over the two registered event masks only
losses.excluded_from_gradient_pair: Huber is excluded because this audit asks specifically whether the newly introduced MR-STFT term conflicts with event BCE

sampling: Every validation batch in folds 1/5/9, batch size 16, shuffle false; final short batch retained
readouts: global cosine over all shared parameter gradients per batch
gradient norm of each objective and their norm ratio
module-group cosine for wsst_stem and every decoder.tcn residual block
per-fold mean, median, negative fraction, <=-0.30 fraction, and deterministic bootstrap 95% CI

decision_rule.global_requirement: Mean global cosine is below zero on 3/3 folds and the batch-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound is below zero on at least 2/3 folds.
decision_rule.localized_requirement: At least one predeclared shared module group has mean cosine <= -0.30 on at least 2/3 folds.
decision_rule.reject_conflict: Otherwise this audit does not support shared-gradient conflict as the cause of the F1 trade-off; do not launch PCGrad from this hypothesis.

prohibitions: No post-hoc layer selection or threshold change
No lambda_event or MR-STFT window tuning as a branch of this audit
